_doc: Cryptographic pins for Gemma coding-harness model files. The reality-loop binary loads this file at start-up and refuses to load any GGUF whose size or sha256 does not match the active pin entry. New entries must include all six fields; missing fields fail closed. Recompute sha256 deliberately when intentionally upgrading.

gemma4_e4b_bf16.description: Gemma 4 E4B Instruction-Tuned, BF16 GGUF (full precision, lossless).
